attrs.note: datasheet - material, colour, the mounting hardware, the two pass-through holes, the detachable cover and the 2.87 in finger duct are the specification table of the finger duct datasheet; RoHS and ISO 9001 are its Standards Compliance list.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger tips along the bottom as along the top, and the side view draws two equal walls in each half; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Reference Guide table of the same datasheet gives CMH-DFD1U per cable type at 30 per cent and 100 per cent fill, and notes that the copper figures are theoretical, for reference only. The figure stated is the Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm row, as for CMH-SFD1U; FS states it for the manager, both channels together, and it is not divided between them.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. The datasheet table gives 44 x 482.6 x 174 mm (1.73 x 19 x 6.85 in). The ears are the ends of the front duct's base plate, as on CMH-SFD1U; the rear duct's base carries none (the top view draws the ear flange once, at the back of the front half). They are not drawn, and the duct between them is CMH-SFD1U's 433 x 42. `depth` STATES THE VENDOR OVERALL 174: the front cover 75.7 in front of the ear plane, the two bases 22.6 behind it, and the rear duct behind them.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn in CMH-SFD1U's shades.

front.note: drawing - the front duct with its cover fitted, the CMH-SFD1U front view: the front view of the datasheet draws it with the cover off, the finger tips end-on and the pass-through holes at the back of the channel. The `duct` guide is the 25 mm between the finger walls, dimensioned 0.98 in [25mm].

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - a dual-sided duct bolts to the front rails with its fingers facing both ways: the front duct stands 75.7 mm in front of the plane of the ears and the rear duct 98.3 behind it (the top view, 174 overall), so it serves the face it is bolted to and the space just behind the rails, and at 174 mm it does not reach the rear rails of a rack. The rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - each duct is the channel between its finger walls, run across the rack; finger pitch and gap are the top view figures above.

left.note: drawing - the side view of CMH-DFD1U: the two joined bases in the middle, two finger walls 27 apart in each half, and the hooked tips each cover clips to, drawn as the cover lips. Both ducts are open at both ends.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. FS publishes one datasheet for CMH-SFD1U, CMH-SFD2U and CMH-DFD1U (Horizontal Cable Managers with Finger Duct), with a front view and a top and side view of each. The front view of CMH-DFD1U is the CMH-SFD1U front view line for line (the same ears, holes 3.03 in [77mm], 6.74 in apart, the 0.98 in [25mm] channel). The top view is two CMH-SFD1U plans back to back, 6.85 in [174mm] overall, each half 3.43 in [87mm] with its 0.47 in [12mm] base, 2.36 in [60mm] fingers and 33.6 mm pitch label; the side view reads 6.7 in [170mm] between the finger tips. So each half is drawn with the four CMH-SFD1U parts, the front half on the front view and the rear half on the rear view.

passes.note: drawing - the two pass-through holes join the two channels through the middle of the part and reach neither outer face, so no face declares a `passes:` entry; they are the holes in each duct's floor.

rear.note: drawing - the rear duct, the same four parts placed the same way: the part is symmetric about its middle, so the rear duct seen from behind is the front duct seen from the front. The straight-on render (x1) and the dual render (g2) show both channels with the same thirteen fingers a row and their own covers. Its own `duct` guide is the same 25 mm channel.

rear-not-drawn.note: drawing - the moulded marks on the bases and the ribs between them are not drawn.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW DUCTS, NOT A BOX. Each half is built as CMH-SFD1U: its base on its own face as a well 75.5 deep whose floor is open at the two pass-through holes, the two rows of fingers standing in it and the cover across the finger tips, which lifts off and opens that channel. The two floors stand 23 apart in the middle of the part; plates sunk just inside the top, bottom and side faces close the joined bases between them, and the holes run through from one channel to the other. Both channels and their ends are open air.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states a wall gauge; 7.3 is the CMH-SFD1U finger wall, and the side view of CMH-DFD1U draws the same walls, 27 mm apart across 42.

top.note: drawing - the top view, rear at y=0: the rear duct's cover 0 to 15, its fingers to 75.7 and its base to 87, then the front duct's base to 98.3, the ear plane, its fingers to 159 and its cover to 174 - the CMH-SFD1U plan and the same plan turned round, as the datasheet draws it. Twelve slots in each half on the CMH-SFD1U 34.1 pitch, 16 wide, each narrowing to a 4 mm neck under its cover.
